current_low_resolution_delivery.approval: v3 style and production mode approved on 2026-10-16; remaining environment batch authorized at low resolution.
current_low_resolution_delivery.blocker: R02 generated and exported after retry; R03 approval timed out. R03-R05 and remaining entities/gates/animations await user-approved retry.

low_resolution_pilot.scope: Revised partial R01 pilot: forest and ground generated together; independent brown stump; user review required before further batches.
low_resolution_pilot.current_focus: Warmer fine soil ground, coordinated stump perspective and independent contact/cast shadow.

scope: Five room modules, separate background/ground/foreground layers, independent entity states and four-direction gates. No game integration or audio.

style_constraints.palette: olive, moss green, gray teal depth, medium brown earth and wood; modest daylight lift
style_constraints.painting: mature hand-painted bitmap look matching approved reference
style_constraints.ordinary_trees: Background layers only; roots and trunks must not grow from or cross the walkable ground layer.
style_constraints.fruit_tree: Independent interactive entity, not an ordinary scenic background tree.

production_contract.alpha: straight RGBA for ground, foreground and entities; background may be RGB if fully opaque
production_contract.camera: side-on three-quarter belt-scroller perspective, no height steps
production_contract.room_layer_alignment: All four exports share the exact room canvas and world origin; no independent reframing or resizing.
production_contract.walkable_area: Broad flat area, approximately lower 60 percent of one-screen composition; exact room bounds remain separate layout data.
production_contract.collision_objects: Entities and gates are independent sprites, never baked into room layers.
production_contract.source_to_export_rule: Every crop or tile must retain original pixels or downsample. Any tile extension needs generated new native detail and checked joins, not stretching or repetition to mimic resolution.

gate_specs.rendering: Export complete geometry and explicit root for each direction. Bottom-edge clipping belongs to room composition, not destructive source trimming. Mirror left/right only after perspective and lamp consistency review.
gate_specs.style: Weathered wood, vines, rope joints and paired amber lamps

root_and_collision.policy: Specify foot root, trim_offset and collision bounds from actual validated export geometry; same root and canvas across each object's state variants.

blockers.evidence: Current image_gen schema limits width/height to 512..2048 and pixel count to 1048576; invalid sizes fall back to 1024x1024. This cannot directly create a native 2560x1440 viewport or the required room canvases.
blockers.resolution: Use a user-approved high-resolution generation route with native detail and verified extension/joins. Never upscale the approved preview.

blockers.evidence: Current image_gen accepts only textual prompts and exposes no image reference or edit input.
blockers.resolution: Use an approved reference-image-capable generator and re-review a representative production sample after changing models.

blockers.evidence: image_gen requests a user approval prompt. Assistant cannot bypass it; no verified image-specific auto-approval setting found in official overview documentation.
blockers.resolution: User must control any available permission setting; do not change or circumvent approvals through scripts.

validation_required: Actual dimensions/mode and source-to-export sampling scale verified; no upscale.
All 20 room layers have matching canvases and origins; seams and transparent borders checked.
No collidable entities, gates or ordinary scenic tree roots baked into the ground.
13 entity/pickup state exports and 8 gate state/direction exports present; roots, bounds and alpha checked.
Torch flame, gate lamp and destructible-hit clips include real frames and documented timing.
Source hashes, real input references, prompts, crop/join records and model outputs retained without credentials.
Native 2K and 0.75-scale offline combinations reviewed; engine/runtime integration remains separate.
